name: svg_animate
description: Animated SVG for Flutter. Plays SMIL and CSS keyframe animations as a drop-in companion to SvgPicture from flutter_svg.

paragraphs: Live demo — the example app, built for the web and running the package rather than describing it. Its Try your own tab takes an SVG of yours, as a file, a URL or pasted markup, and reports what compiling it produced: how many frames, how many of those actually differ, what they cost, and anything in the file that will not survive being drawn.
Plays SVGs that declare their own animation — SMIL (, , , ), CSS @keyframes, and CSS motion paths — using the same vectorgraphics renderer that fluttersvg draws still SVGs with.
The image above is a single SVG file, animating in your browser exactly as it does in Flutter through this package. Its source is doc/demo.svg.
